item.title: Comment on One early report on congestion pricing in NYC by Matt
item.description:
" It remains to be seen if central Manhattan has a path to becoming truly pleasant in the Nordic sense."

This (and much of your writing on this topic) seem like a bizarre straw-man to me. It's one of those topics where you've really let your feelings get the better of careful evaluation and argument. I think it would serve you well to try to look at both this, and your writting on it, with a more dispassionate eye.
